# Furina ML

> Train scikit-learn models on your own CSV files: inspect, clean, tune, train, evaluate and predict, without writing code.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://furina.nevatal.id/
- API: https://furina.nevatal.id/api/
- API Catalog: https://furina.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://furina.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://furina.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://furina.nevatal.id/auth.md
